'''Project Lasercutter''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operation led by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. It aimed to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in order to disrupt Rebel supply lines. Their operation on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] made use of a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within the Alliance who fed them information on the whereabouts of top smugglers. Using this information, they almost captured [[Jaxa Lian]], but were foiled by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] instructed by local Rebel agent [[Hantor Loftus]]. Their spy, [[Lidek Baws]] was later killed along with a number of their agents in retaliation by the Rebels. Finally, the Inquisitor in charge of the operation was also killed on Tatooine.
